privacy: See AI, operated by Mahmoud Saad Mohamed Shafie Darhous — Faqous, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt. Email: See@seeai.xyz. We are responsible for your personal data.

Your email address when you join the waitlist — nothing else. We do not collect your phone number or any other data. Your IP address also reaches us when you visit the site. When subscriptions open, payment details are collected and processed by our merchant of record, Paddle — we do not see or store your card details.
Only to notify you when the platform launches, with your explicit consent when you sign up. We do not use your email for any other purpose.

Waitlist messages reach our inbox through FormSubmit, and ipwho.is checks your IP address to detect VPN connections. Payments are processed by Paddle as merchant of record. We do not sell your data or share it with anyone else, unless the law requires it.
Waitlist messages may be stored on servers outside Egypt through our email provider, with your explicit consent when you sign up, in line with Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020.

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing and withdraw your consent at any time — email us at See@seeai.xyz and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Personal Data Protection Center.
We keep your email until the platform launches or until you ask us to delete it — email us and we will delete it right away. We store no data on your device.

terms: Operator
See Image is operated by Mahmoud Saad Mohamed Shafie Darhous, based in Faqous, Sharqia Governorate, Egypt. Email: See@seeai.xyz.
Acceptance
By using See Image you agree to this agreement. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
The service
See Image is an image-generation and chat platform, still under preparation. The model is not available yet and will open at launch. Features and prices may change before launch.
Limits
Free use is limited to a small number of images each day. Paid plans have higher limits. Limits may change at launch.
Chat
Chat offers two modes: Text to Image and Image to Image.
Subscriptions and payments

Two monthly plans are offered: Starter at $7 a month and Pro at $14 a month. Payments are processed by our merchant of record, Paddle. Payment processing fees (5% + $0.50 per payment) are added at checkout and paid by the subscriber: $7.85 in total for Starter and $15.20 in total for Pro. Subscriptions renew monthly until cancelled. You can cancel at any time; the plan stays active until the end of the current billing month. No custom model training (LoRA) is offered on this platform.
Your account
When the platform opens, sign-in will be with your Google account, and you are responsible for your account and all activity under it.
Acceptable use
Do not create illegal or abusive content, infringe others’ rights, or impersonate real people, and do not use the platform for any unlawful purpose.
Content

You own the images and text you create within the limits of the law, and grant us the right to run and show them to you only. The images shown on the home page are illustrative examples, not model output.
Liability and governing law

The service is provided “as is” without any warranty. We are not liable for any harm arising from using the platform. This agreement is governed by Egyptian law, and the Egyptian courts have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.

thaana.chatReply: ޝުކުރިއްޔާ — ޗެޓް ހުޅުވާނީ ލޯންޗްގައި، އަދި ތިޔަ މެސެޖް ސޭވްވީ މި ޑިވައިސްގައި އެކަނި. ލޯންޗް ޚަބަރު See@seeai.xyz އިން އީމެއިލްކުރާނަން.
thaana.chatSoon: ޗެޓް ހުޅުވާނީ ލޯންޗްގައި. ތިޔަ މެސެޖް ރަހައްޓާނީ މި ޑިވައިސްގައި އެކަނި — އަދި އެއްޗެއް ނުފޮނުވޭ.

thaana.heroSub: ސީ އިމޭޖް 1.0 — ޢަރަބި ލިޔުން ސައްހަކޮށް، ސައްހަ ތަނުގައި ލިޔެވޭ ފޮޓޯ މޮޑެލެއް.
